name: TagSpaces
description_en: TagSpaces is an offline, cross-platform file manager and organiser that also can function as a note taking app. The WebDAV version of the application can be installed on top of a WebDAV servers such as Nextcloud or ownCloud. ([Demo](https://demo.tagspaces.com), [Source Code](https://github.com/tagspaces/tagspaces)) `AGPL-3.0` `Nodejs`
